members.description: A set of memebers. The value can be "allUsers", "user:{email}", "group:{email}", "serviceAccount:{email}" or "workloadIdentity:{email}".

role.description: The role full name in roles/{id} format.

database.description: The accessible database full name in instances/{instance resource id}/databases/{database name} format. Only works for the role with bb.sql.x permissions.

environment_ids.description: The environment ID list to allow the DDL/DML operation in the SQL Editor. Only works for the role with bb.sql.ddl or bb.sql.dml permissions.

expire_timestamp.description: The expiration timestamp in YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format

schema.description: The accessible schema in the database. Must configure with the database.

tables.description: The accessible table list. Must configure with the database.

block.description: The binding in the IAM policy.

domain.description: The domain for email matching when using this identity provider.

name.description: The identity provider full name in idps/{resource id} format.

resource_id.description: The identity provider unique resource id.

type.description: The identity provider type. One of OAUTH2, OIDC, LDAP.

block.description: The identity provider data source list.

activation.description: Whether assign license for this instance or not.

databases.description: The databases full name in the resource.

engine.description: The instance engine. Supported engines: MYSQL, POSTGRES, TIDB, SNOWFLAKE, CLICKHOUSE, MONGODB, SQLITE, REDIS, ORACLE, SPANNER, MSSQL, REDSHIFT, MARIADB, OCEANBASE, STARROCKS, DORIS, HIVE, ELASTICSEARCH, BIGQUERY, DYNAMODB, DATABRICKS, COCKROACHDB, COSMOSDB, TRINO, CASSANDRA.

environment.description: The environment name for your instance in "environments/{resource id}" format.

external_link.description: The external console URL managing this instance (e.g. AWS RDS console, your in-house DB instance console)

list_all_databases.description: List all databases in this instance. If false, will only list 500 databases.

name.description: The instance full name in instances/{resource id} format.

sync_databases.description: Enable sync for following databases. Default empty, means sync all schemas & databases.

sync_interval.description: How often the instance is synced in seconds. Default 0, means never sync.

environment.description: The environment full name. Filter instances by environment.

project.description: The project full name. Filter instances by project.

query.description: Filter instances by name or resource id with wildcard

state.description: Filter instances by state. Default ACTIVE.

enforce.description: Decide if the policy is enforced.

inherit_from_parent.description: Decide if the policy should inherit from the parent.

name.description: The policy full name

parent.description: The policy parent name for the policy, support workspaces/{workspace id}, projects/{resource id}, environments/{resource id}, instances/{resource id}, or instances/{resource id}/databases/{database name}. Defaults to the workspace if not specified.

database.description: The database full name in instances/{instance resource id}/databases/{database name} format

expire_timestamp.description: The expiration timestamp in YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.000Z format

raw_expression.description: The raw CEL expression. We will use it as the masking exemption and ignore the "database"/"schema"/"table"/"columns"/"expire_timestamp" fields if you provide the raw expression.

reason.description: The reason for the masking exemption

allow_admin_data_source.description: Allow using the admin data source to query in the SQL editor. If true, users can select the admin data source or read-only data source. If false, when read-only data source is configured, users are forced to use the read-only data source; otherwise fallback to admin data source.

disable_copy_data.description: Disable copying data in the SQL editor

disable_export.description: Disable export data in the SQL editor

maximum_result_rows.description: The return rows limit. If the value <= 0, will be treated as no limit. The default value is -1.

automatic.description: If all check pass, the change will be rolled out and executed automatically.

roles.description: If any roles are specified, Bytebase requires users with those roles to manually roll out the change.

parent.description: The policy parent name for the policy, support workspaces/{workspace id}, projects/{resource id}, environments/{resource id}, instances/{resource id}, or instances/{resource id}/databases/{database name}. Defaults to the workspace if not specified.

allow_just_in_time_access.description: Whether to allow just-in-time access in this project.

allow_request_role.description: Whether to allow requesting roles in this project.

allow_self_approval.description: Whether to allow the issue creator to self-approve the issue.

data_classification_config_id.description: The data classification configuration ID for the project.

databases.description: The databases full name in the resource.

enforce_issue_title.description: Enforce issue title created by user instead of generated by Bytebase.

enforce_sql_review.description: Whether to enforce SQL review checks to pass before issue creation.

force_issue_labels.description: Force issue labels to be used when creating an issue.

issue_labels.description: Labels available for tagging issues in this project.

labels.description: Labels are key-value pairs that can be attached to the project.

name.description: The project full name in projects/{resource id} format.

postgres_database_tenant_mode.description: Whether to enable the database tenant mode for PostgreSQL. If enabled, the issue will be created with the pre-appended "set role <db_owner>" statement.

require_issue_approval.description: Whether to require issue approval before rollout.

require_plan_check_no_error.description: Whether to require plan check to have no error before rollout.

webhooks.description: The webhooks in the project. When url is write-only, webhook identity for diffing uses the (title, type) pair, and duplicate (title, type) pairs are rejected at plan time.

exclude_default.description: If not include the default project in the response.

query.description: Filter projects by name or resource id with wildcard.

state.description: Filter projects by state. Default ACTIVE.

resource_id.description: The unique resource id for the review config.

resources.description: Resources using the config. We support attach the review config for environments or projects with format {resurce}/{resource id}. For example, environments/test, projects/sample.

title.description: The title for the review config.

block.description: The review config data source list.

name.description: The role full name in roles/{resource id} format.

create_time.description: The timestamp when the service account was created.

name.description: The service account name in serviceAccounts/{email} format.

title.description: The display title of the service account.

parent.description: The parent resource. Format: projects/{project} for project-level, workspaces/{workspace id} for workspace-level. Defaults to the workspace if not specified.

show_deleted.description: Show deleted service accounts if specified.

block.description: The service account data source list.

app_im.description: The APP_IM workspace setting. Configures Slack/Feishu/Wecom/Lark/DingTalk/Teams integrations. All credential and identifier fields are write-only — the server returns empty payloads on GET, so values cannot round-trip through state.

name.description: The setting name in settings/{name} format. The name support "WORKSPACE_APPROVAL", "WORKSPACE_PROFILE", "DATA_CLASSIFICATION", "SEMANTIC_TYPES", "ENVIRONMENT", "APP_IM". Check the proto https://github.com/bytebase/bytebase/blob/release/3.17.0/proto/v1/v1/setting_service.proto#L104 for details

rules.description: Rules are evaluated in order, first matching rule applies.

block.description: Configure risk level and approval flow for different tasks. Require ENTERPRISE subscription.

id.description: The classification unique id, must in {number}-{number} format.

level.description: The classification sensitivity level. Maps to Level.level.
The numeric level for ordering. Higher means more sensitive.

block.description: Classification for data masking. Require ENTERPRISE subscription.

substitution.description: Substitution is the string used to replace the original value, the max length of the string is 16 bytes.
Substitution is the string used to replace the inner or outer substring.

salt.description: Salt is the salt value to generate a different hash that with the word alone.

end.description: End is the stop index of the original value, should be less than the length of the original value.

start.description: Start is the start index of the original value, start from 0 and should be less than stop.

substitution.description: Substitution is the string used to replace the OriginalValue[start:end).

block.description: Semantic types for data masking. Require ENTERPRISE subscription.

access_token_duration_in_seconds.description: The duration for access token in seconds. Default is 3600 (1 hour). The duration should be at least 60 (one minute).

database_change_mode.description: The workspace database change mode, support EDITOR or PIPELINE. Default PIPELINE

disallow_password_signin.description: Whether to disallow password signin (except workspace admins). Require ENTERPRISE subscription

disallow_signup.description: Disallow self-service signup, users can only be invited by the owner. Require PRO subscription.

domains.description: The workspace domain, e.g. bytebase.com. Required for the group

enable_audit_log_stdout.description: Enable audit logging to stdout in structured JSON format. Requires TEAM or ENTERPRISE license.

enforce_identity_domain.description: Only user and group from the domains can be created and login.

external_url.description: The URL user visits Bytebase. The external URL is used for: 1. Constructing the correct callback URL when configuring the VCS provider. The callback URL points to the frontend; 2. Creating the correct webhook endpoint when configuring the project GitOps workflow. The webhook endpoint points to the backend.

maximum_role_expiration_in_seconds.description: The max duration in seconds for role expired. If the value is less than or equal to 0, we will remove the setting. AKA no limit.

query_timeout_in_seconds.description: The maximum time allowed for a query to run in SQL Editor, in seconds. No limit when the value <= 0.

refresh_token_duration_in_seconds.description: The duration for refresh token in seconds. Default is 604800 (7 days). The duration should be at least 3600 (one hour).

sql_result_size.description: The size limit in bytes for SQL query results. The default value is 100MB.

watermark.description: Whether to display watermark on pages. Requires ENTERPRISE license.

link.description: The optional link, user can follow the link to check extra details

text.description: The text of announcement. Leave it as empty string can clear the announcement

block.description: Custom announcement. Will show as a banner in the Bytebase UI. Require ENTERPRISE subscription.

min_length.description: min_length is the minimum length for password, should be no less than 8.

password_rotation_in_seconds.description: password_rotation requires users to reset their password after the duration. The duration should be at least 86400 (one day).

require_letter.description: require_letter requires the password must contain at least one letter, regardless of upper case or lower case.

require_number.description: require_number requires the password must contain at least one number.

require_reset_password_for_first_login.description: require_reset_password_for_first_login requires users to reset their password after the 1st login.

require_special_character.description: require_special_character requires the password must contain at least one special character.

require_uppercase_letter.description: require_uppercase_letter requires the password must contain at least one upper case letter.

last_change_password_time.description: The user last change password time.

mfa_enabled.description: The mfa_enabled flag means if the user has enabled MFA.

name.description: The user name in users/{email} format.

source.description: Source means where the user comes from. For now we support Entra ID SCIM sync, so the source could be Entra ID.

state.description: The user is deleted or not.

email.description: Filter users by email with wildcard

name.description: Filter users by name with wildcard

project.description: The project full name. Filter users by project.

state.description: Filter users by state. Default ACTIVE.

create_time.description: The timestamp when the workload identity was created.

name.description: The workload identity name in workloadIdentities/{email} format.

title.description: The display title of the workload identity.

workload_identity_config.description: The workload identity configuration for OIDC token validation.

parent.description: The parent resource. Format: projects/{project} for project-level, workspaces/{workspace id} for workspace-level. Defaults to the workspace if not specified.

show_deleted.description: Show deleted workload identities if specified.

block.description: The workload identity data source list.

logo.description: The branding logo as a data URI (e.g. data:image/png;base64,...).

name.description: The workspace full name in workspaces/{id} format.

subscription.description: The current subscription of the workspace.
